name: llm-thinkers
description: Breadth-first ideation panel triggered by the phrase `use thinkers`. Fans out to three thinkers on fixed models (gpt-5.5-medium, claude-opus-4-7-thinking-xhigh, gemini-3.1-pro), merges and de-duplicates their options, then hands off to the `llm-council` pack for ranking.
notes: Step 3 of this protocol hands off to the `llm-council` pack (`llm-council.mdc`). Install the `llm-council` pack alongside this one so the ranking handoff resolves; both packs together give you breadth-first ideation followed by structured ranking.
